burr: 39 mm high-nitrogen martensitic stainless conical (Nitro Blade)

source.title: Honest Coffee Guide: Comandante C40 MK4 grind settings
source.notes: Comandante's FAQ says AeroPress 'depends on recipe'. Coffeedesk: 10–15 concentrate, 20–22 standard, 24–28 long steep.

source.title: Honest Coffee Guide pour-over upper half (16–34); Coffeedesk 40–45 is an outlier beyond most units' range
Honest Coffee Guide: Comandante C40 MK4 grind settings

procedure.en: Hold the grinder horizontally. With the burrs open the handle falls to 6 o'clock. Tighten click by click; zero is the first click where the handle no longer falls. Count clicks counter-clockwise from there.
procedure.pt-BR: Segure o moedor na horizontal. Com as mós abertas a manivela cai para as 6 horas. Aperte clique a clique; o zero é o primeiro clique em que a manivela não cai mais. Conte os cliques no sentido anti-horário a partir dali.

notes: 30 µm per click is retailer copy (Prima Coffee, Rogue Wave); Comandante does not publish it. MK3 and MK4 share burrs and clicks; MK4's polymer jar adds static, so some users go 1–2 clicks finer. Red Clix doubles the click count (24 per rotation): multiply every value by 2.
